title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch Solid Brass Wire, Oval Combination | Satin Nickel | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your shower storage with an oval combination basket crafted from solid brass and ventilated wire for drainage in a space-saving wall mount design in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms.

  • Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware for a finished look.
  • Finish flexibility: Available in a wide variety of designer finish options, including statement colors.
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Specs

  • Category: Basket
  • Product: Oval Combination Shower Basket
  • Style: Traditional (coordinates with classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures)
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Dimensions: 18.75-Inch L x 4.13-Inch W x 2.25-Inch H
  • Projection: 4.13-Inch
  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Included: Basket and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
